remarks:
So many updates have already been completed at 12 Ashley Place in Lockport, making this spacious home a fantastic opportunity for an owner or investor looking for flexibility, functionality, and room for everyone!

Currently configured as a two-unit home, the first floor features 2 bedrooms, a full bathroom, kitchen, and living room. Upstairs offers 3 additional bedrooms, a full bathroom, kitchen, and a covered deck where you can relax and enjoy views of the city landscape.  There is 1 furnace, 1 hot water tank, 1 breaker box.

The possibilities are endless! This property would make an excellent in-law arrangement, multi-generational home, or investment property, and it could easily be converted back to a spacious single-family residence.

The driveway and carport provide parking for up to 3 vehicles.

Numerous major updates have already been completed, including:

Tear-off roof (2020),
Furnace (2020),
Hot water tank (2020),
Replacement windows throughout,
Laminate flooring,
Full attic - offering additional storage potential.
For buyers using conventional financing, the upper-level kitchen could be converted into a second-floor laundry room, creating an even more traditional single-family layout.

With its generous room count, flexible floor plan, numerous updates, 12 Ashley Place offers an exciting opportunity to make the space work for your unique needs! Property can be vacant if buyer requests
